title: Build The Hollow Beneath Emberfall hello-world adventure module
description:
Create a small first-party starter adventure module - The Hollow Beneath Emberfall - that serves as Eshyra's gameplay hello-world module.

The Emberfall setting itself should remain setting-scale campaign template content. This work adds a separate scenario-scale module located within or near Emberfall. The module should be intentionally small and useful for testing real play: opening hook, locations, scenes, at least one social beat, exploration, encounter resolution, reward, ending states, persistence, and resume.

Naming glossary (ADR 0012):
- Emberfall - the setting-scale village/region; campaign template. Preserve as setting content.
- The Hollow Beneath Emberfall - this starter adventure module (scenario-scale).
- Ember Hollow - informal shorthand only; not a separate canonical entity. (The ember-hollow label is a project tag, not a third concept.)
- EMBERFALL_HOLLOW - the existing legacy sample that conflates setting and scenario, to be split by this work.
design:
Target size:
- 3 to 5 keyed locations
- 1 to 2 combat-capable encounters
- 1 social encounter
- 1 exploration obstacle
- 3 to 6 secrets or clues
- 1 meaningful choice
- 1 reward
- 2 to 3 possible ending states

The purpose is engine coverage and product shape, not a large polished adventure. The module is immutable authored scenario source; play progress is recorded in the campaign-owned adventure run / module binding (eshyra-eh54.4), not in the module.
acceptance_criteria:
- A small first-party starter adventure module (The Hollow Beneath Emberfall) exists.
- The module is scenario-scale, not a replacement for the Emberfall campaign template/setting.
- The module exercises the adventure module schema, loader, campaign-owned adventure run / module binding and progress, runtime context, and progress persistence.
- The module supports a short playable path suitable for smoke testing.
- The module has enough structure to test hidden secrets, objectives, encounters, rewards, and alternate outcomes.
close_reason: All children complete (.1 outline #268, .2 fixture #269, .3 smoke #270). The Hollow Beneath Emberfall starter module exists as immutable source, loads via the loader, binds to a campaign, feeds the DM runtime context, and round-trips through persistence.
